main.description: List the labelers registered on this relay, in ascending DID order. Public endpoint, rate limited per client IP.

limit.description: Maximum number of labelers to return. Values outside 1-100 are rejected with InvalidRequest, not clamped.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor: the did of the last labeler on the previous page. Pass the cursor from a response back to fetch the next page; a response without a cursor is the last page.

enabled.description: Filter by registry enabled state. When absent, all labelers are returned. Only the literal strings true and false are accepted.

labelers.description: Registered labelers in ascending DID order. Empty array when nothing matches.

cursor.description: The did of the last labeler on this page. Present only when further pages exist.
